The following table lists the warm node instance types and the maximum amount of storage that
each type can use. For OpenSearch Optimized OI2 instances, 80% of the local storage is available
as cache, and the maximum addressable warm storage is 5 times the cache storage size.
For example, if an OI2 instance has 468 GB of local storage:
• Cache storage = 375 GB (80% of local storage)
• Maximum addressable warm storage = 1875 GB (5 x 375 GB cache)
